Polynomials, degree and zeroes: Degree 1, 2, 3 are linear, quadratic, cubic; a zero k satisfies p(k) = 0.
Zeroes and graphs of polynomials: Zeroes are x-intercepts; a quadratic has 0, 1 or 2 real zeroes.
Relationship between zeroes and coeffici: Quadratic: sum of zeroes = −b/a, product = c/a.
Cubic polynomials and the division algor: Cubic relations use −b/a, c/a, −d/a; p(x) = g(x)q(x) + r(x).
